issues.description: Image frame uses raw RGB bytes but PIL image mode is not converted, producing corrupted output
issues.detail: Gemini returns PNG/JPEG bytes which PIL opens with whatever mode the source has (often RGBA or P). Calling image.tobytes() without image.convert('RGB') will yield bytes whose length and channel layout don't match the declared 'RGB' format, causing garbled images downstream. Should convert to RGB before tobytes().

issues.description: Monkey-patching genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE at import time is fragile
issues.detail: Mutating a private attribute of the google-genai SDK module at import time is described as a 'temporary hack' but has no version pin, fallback, or guard. Future SDK versions may remove or rename _api_client, breaking import for all Google service users (not just image models). At minimum wrap in try/except and scope to image-model usage.

issues.description: Default model change from gemini-2.0-flash to gemini-2.5-flash is a breaking behavioral change
issues.detail: Changing the default model silently alters cost, latency, and response characteristics for every existing user who didn't pin a model. The CHANGELOG mentions it under 'Changed' but this should be called out as potentially breaking. Consider a deprecation notice or version bump rationale.

issues.description: Image-model detection via substring 'image' in model name is brittle
issues.detail: Checking `if 'image' in self._model_name` will match any future model name containing 'image' as a substring, and miss image-capable models that don't. Same concern for the part.inline_data branch which fires for any inline data regardless of model. Prefer checking part.inline_data.mime_type starts with 'image/'.

issues.description: Example file uses TTS pipeline but image-generation model output won't be spoken
issues.detail: 07n-interruptible-gemini-image.py wires gemini-2.5-flash-image through a TTS pipeline, but image-generation responses produce images, not text. The example doesn't demonstrate how images reach the video output (video_out_enabled is set but no consumer is shown wiring OutputImageRawFrame to transport). The example may confuse users about the actual data flow.

issues.description: Image size assumed square 1024x1024 in transport but Gemini may return other sizes
issues.detail: video_out_width/height are hard-coded to 1024 in the example, but Gemini image outputs aren't guaranteed to be that size. If the actual image size differs from transport config, frames may be rejected or scaled unexpectedly. Worth a comment or dynamic sizing note.

review.summary: The PR adds image-generation support to GoogleLLMService, but the new code path has a likely correctness bug: PIL images opened from inline_data bytes are passed via tobytes() without mode conversion, which will produce corrupted output for non-RGB source images. The monkey-patch of genai._api_client.READ_BUFFER_SIZE at import time is acknowledged as a hack and should be hardened. The default model change is a behavioral break worth surfacing more clearly, and substring-based image-model detection is brittle. The example file usefully demonstrates wiring but doesn't show how generated images actually reach the transport output.
